mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, COUNT(s.id) AS count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.class_id = c.id AND s.status = 'active' WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.class_name, c.grade_year ORDER BY c.grade_year DESC, c.id ASC
